# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image testing and rendering reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image comparison tools and improves rendering reliability. The separate SkiaSharp.Testing package supports image acceptance policies and visual diagnostics. Runtime-effect uniforms start cleared, Windows x64 decoder error recovery is corrected, and Ganesh texture sampling stays inside subset edges. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 applications to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Applications relying on those assets must move to a supported Linux architecture, such as x64 or ARM64, before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and creates caller-owned difference images. The assembly is experimental: consumers must explicitly opt in by suppressing diagnostic SKIA4001. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows x64 decoder error recovery** — Fixes process crashes when libjpeg or libpng uses longjmp to recover from an error in clang-built Windows x64 natives. This includes malformed JPEG input to SKCodec.Create and PDF processing of lazy non-JPEG images. Other Windows architectures and MSVC builds are unchanged. — ❤️ [@SimonCropp](https://github.com/SimonCropp) ([#5827](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5827))
- **Defined runtime-effect uniform contents** — New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers are zeroed rather than containing leftover memory. Reset() now clears the existing buffer in place, avoiding a native buffer and wrapper allocation on each call. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))
- **Trim-safe MAUI window binding** — SKGLView uses a statically expressed Window binding instead of a string path, removing the trimming warning from that binding in trimmed MAUI applications without changing its behavior. — ❤️ [@bhall-ctre](https://github.com/bhall-ctre) ([#5320](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5320))
- **Texture subset edges and Tizen blur selection** — Ganesh bilinear sampling clamps slightly inside texture subsets to avoid undefined exterior texels; CPU and Graphite sampling are unchanged. Tizen now applies its intended CPU blur-path selection when compiling Skia. Texture-edge pixels may change, and Tizen blur output and performance may differ. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))

## Engine

- **Skia m159 servicing update** — Integrates upstream bug fixes within Skia m159 without changing managed bindings or package versions in the engine-sync change. ([#5841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5841))
